description: PIRAGUA_hydro_analysis is a CSIC release of monthly water-balance components and river discharge for Pyrenean sub-basins during 1981–2010. The project drove SASER and SWAT hydrological models with its separate daily PIRAGUA atmospheric analysis. Variables include snowfall, snowmelt, actual and potential evapotranspiration, soil storage, aquifer recharge, runoff and discharge. The provider page lists GIS and tabular ZIP files plus a README, and states the Open Database License 1.0. Coverage includes catchments across Spain, France and Andorra, with values aggregated to hydrographic sub-basins, not individual intakes, reservoirs or pipes. Model structural choices and forcing uncertainty are limitations; model output must not be represented as direct measurements. A reviewer-assessed simulation use is comparing regional water-availability assumptions or checking catchment-model outputs. platform-ewatercycle-hydrological-modelling is a related modelling environment, but no direct compatibility was verified. The article also describes a separate R recipe notebook for exploring these tables. No archive or CSV was downloaded or analysed.
